notice: Terrain from NASA MRO HiRISE (1 m, averaged to 10 m cells). Positions from NASA's Perseverance position file, except Kodiak (team-read, to be re-checked in Mars Trek).

coordinateSystem.origin: Three Forks sample depot (18.4529 N, 77.4083 E) at (0, 0); Mars equirectangular, R = 3,396,190 m, east-west corrected to ground metres.

geographicReference.notice: NASA rover position file (S23) matched to sample dates (S24); agrees with JPL depot zones (S22)

stops.name: Cape Nukshak

stops.observationObjective: Exposed delta stack and the way up the scarp: layering, contacts, sample targets.

stops.name: Kodiak butte
stops.observationObjective: Isolated delta remnant viewed from its foot: inclined layers record lake-level changes.

layers.attribution: NASA/JPL/University of Arizona, MRO HiRISE orthomosaic (25 cm, shown at 2 m) via USGS Astrogeology
NASA/JPL/University of Arizona, MRO HiRISE DTM via USGS Astrogeology; slope 0-30 degrees, 10 m cells
Random forest on HiRISE slope, roughness, brightness and texture + THEMIS night IR; sand (yellow), bedrock (grey), rough (rust), steep (purple, measured slope > 15 degrees); opacity = confidence
NASA Mars Odyssey THEMIS Night IR Controlled Mosaic v2 (USGS Astrogeology), 100 m. Relative night-time warmth: brighter = stays warm (rockier), darker = cools fast (sandier)

classifier.method: Random forest, 4-fold spatial cross-validation over 1 km blocks
classifier.steepRule: Steep is measured, not predicted: cell mean slope over 15 degrees
classifier.limits: Labels come from one AI-assisted labeller on HiRISE image patches, partly re-checked blind by two teammates; sand and rough are often confused. Treat classes as a guide, not ground truth.

routes.limits: A rover is not an astronaut, and only legs the rover actually drove are a fair comparison.

sources.source: USGS Astrogeology, Mars 2020 Jezero landing site products

sources.note: Bilinear resample from 100 m; cannot resolve features within one THEMIS pixel; night IR brightness is a relative proxy for thermal inertia, not calibrated
